_meta.note: 一個故事一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

A People's Sovereign#001.src: This trapdoor is locked. Maybe you can find a key to open it?
A People's Sovereign#001.dst: Bu yer kapağı kilitli. Belki onu açacak bir anahtar bulabilirsin?

A People's Sovereign#003.src: I cannot say that I have seen you around here before...
A People's Sovereign#003.dst: Seni daha önce buralarda gördüğümü söyleyemem...
A People's Sovereign#003.speaker: Girazh

A People's Sovereign#005.src: But besides that, your colors! Where are they?
A People's Sovereign#005.dst: Ama bir yana, renklerin! Nerede onlar?
A People's Sovereign#005.speaker: Girazh

A People's Sovereign#006.src: Such a monotonous form is too strange a sight in this colorful country!
A People's Sovereign#006.dst: Bu rengârenk ülkede böyle tekdüze bir görünüş fazlasıyla tuhaf kaçıyor!
A People's Sovereign#006.speaker: Girazh

A People's Sovereign#007.src: Do not worry. I can sell you something beautiful!
A People's Sovereign#007.dst: Merak etme. Sana güzel bir şey satabilirim!
A People's Sovereign#007.speaker: Girazh

A People's Sovereign#008.src: For {~} EB, this dye can be yours! If you want it, of course.
A People's Sovereign#008.dst: {c2}{~} EB{/} karşılığında bu boya senin olabilir! Tabii istersen.
A People's Sovereign#008.speaker: Girazh

A People's Sovereign#009.src: You... do not want my dye?
A People's Sovereign#009.speaker: Girazh

A People's Sovereign#010.src: I'm giving it to you for a very good price. {~} EB is practically throwing it away on someone like you, who clearly does not appreciate the beauty of color.
A People's Sovereign#010.dst: Sana çok iyi bir fiyat veriyorum. Rengin güzelliğini belli ki takdir etmeyen senin gibi birine {c2}{~} EB{/} istemek, onu neredeyse bedavaya vermek demek.
A People's Sovereign#010.speaker: Girazh

A People's Sovereign#011.src: Fine, no worry. I shall hold it for you, until you decide to return.
A People's Sovereign#011.dst: Peki, dert değil. Dönmeye karar verene kadar onu senin için saklarım.
A People's Sovereign#011.speaker: Girazh

A People's Sovereign#014.src: All that can be fixed, for the low price of {~} EB!
A People's Sovereign#014.dst: Bunların hepsi sadece {c2}{~} EB{/} gibi düşük bir fiyata düzeltilebilir!
A People's Sovereign#014.speaker: Girazh

A People's Sovereign#015.src: If you want it, of course.
A People's Sovereign#015.speaker: Girazh

A People's Sovereign#016.dst: Mükemmel. Tam da ihtiyacın olan şey!
A People's Sovereign#016.speaker: Girazh

A People's Sovereign#018.src: Why have you not used your gift?
A People's Sovereign#018.speaker: Girazh

A People's Sovereign#019.src: Dye is a high value item around here, someone is sure to want it!
A People's Sovereign#019.dst: Boya buralarda çok değerli bir şey, birileri mutlaka ister!
A People's Sovereign#019.speaker: Girazh

A People's Sovereign#020.src: Why not try and look on our upper floors?
A People's Sovereign#020.speaker: Girazh

A People's Sovereign#021.src: You are sure to find a buyer eventually.
A People's Sovereign#021.dst: Eninde sonunda mutlaka bir alıcı bulursun.
A People's Sovereign#021.speaker: Girazh

A People's Sovereign#022.src: I have not seen your face before.
A People's Sovereign#022.speaker: Robboss

A People's Sovereign#023.src: Nor your colors, come to think... I've never seen clothes in such a lurid shade of 'used'!
A People's Sovereign#023.dst: Renklerini de, şimdi düşününce... Hiç bu kadar cart bir 'kullanılmış' tonunda kıyafet görmemiştim!
A People's Sovereign#023.speaker: Robboss

A People's Sovereign#024.src: No matter, it can be sorted ou—
A People's Sovereign#024.speaker: Robboss

A People's Sovereign#025.src: Not one for beauty then, are you?
A People's Sovereign#025.dst: Demek güzellikten pek anlamıyorsun, öyle mi?
A People's Sovereign#025.speaker: Robboss

A People's Sovereign#026.src: Come back to me once you've changed your appetite...
A People's Sovereign#026.speaker: Robboss

A People's Sovereign#027.src: You! May I take a look at something that I hear you've received?
A People's Sovereign#027.dst: Sen! Aldığını duyduğum bir şeye bakabilir miyim?
A People's Sovereign#027.speaker: Nawild

A People's Sovereign#029.src: I am in need of some dye ingredients, you see.
A People's Sovereign#029.speaker: Nawild

A People's Sovereign#030.src: I will gladly speak to you again once you have them!
A People's Sovereign#030.dst: Onları bulduğunda seninle seve seve yeniden konuşurum!
A People's Sovereign#030.speaker: Nawild

A People's Sovereign#033.src: Purple dye residue? I'm not too sure what you think you can do with that.
A People's Sovereign#033.dst: {c1}Mor boya tortusu{c2} mu? Bununla ne yapabileceğini düşündüğünden pek emin değilim.{/}
A People's Sovereign#033.speaker: Bassow

A People's Sovereign#034.src: I'm sure that whomever you bought it from is glad to have it out of their hands, though...
A People's Sovereign#034.dst: Gerçi onu kimden aldıysan elinden çıkardığına eminim seviniyordur...
A People's Sovereign#034.speaker: Bassow

A People's Sovereign#035.src: How about I give you this to solve your dye problem.
A People's Sovereign#035.dst: Boya sorununu çözmek için sana bunu versem nasıl olur?
A People's Sovereign#035.speaker: Bassow

A People's Sovereign#036.src: Enjoy, stranger. Someone around these grounds will trade for these readily.
A People's Sovereign#036.dst: Tadını çıkar, yabancı. Buralarda biri bunları seve seve takas eder.
A People's Sovereign#036.speaker: Bassow

A People's Sovereign#038.src: I've already given you my present, dull one!
A People's Sovereign#038.dst: Sana hediyemi zaten verdim, donuk şey!
A People's Sovereign#038.speaker: Bassow

A People's Sovereign#039.src: If you want more presents, speak to someone else.
A People's Sovereign#039.dst: Daha fazla hediye istiyorsan {c2}başka biriyle konuş{/}.
A People's Sovereign#039.speaker: Bassow

A People's Sovereign#041.src: But, I don't believe I've seen you here before...
A People's Sovereign#041.dst: Ama seni daha önce burada gördüğümü sanmıyorum...
A People's Sovereign#041.speaker: Nawild

A People's Sovereign#042.src: And therefore, you have no use for these dye ingredients that you've been given, correct?
A People's Sovereign#042.dst: Dolayısıyla sana verilen bu boya malzemelerine ihtiyacın yok, doğru mu?
A People's Sovereign#042.speaker: Nawild

A People's Sovereign#043.src: No matter! I have something to give you that will equal their value tenfold!
A People's Sovereign#043.dst: Fark etmez! Sana değerlerinin on katı eden bir şey verebilirim!
A People's Sovereign#043.speaker: Nawild

A People's Sovereign#047.src: If, however, you find yourself not in need of a peacock feather, there will certainly be someone around here who may heavily reward you for this deal in their own right!
A People's Sovereign#047.dst: Ama tavus kuşu tüyüne ihtiyacın yoksa, {c2}buralarda mutlaka{/} bu takas için seni kendi usulünce cömertçe ödüllendirecek biri vardır!
A People's Sovereign#047.speaker: Nawild

A People's Sovereign#050.src: I'm sorry stranger, but I have nothing more to give you.
A People's Sovereign#050.dst: Üzgünüm yabancı, sana verecek başka bir şeyim yok.
A People's Sovereign#050.speaker: Nawild

A People's Sovereign#051.src: I'll let you know if that ever changes!
A People's Sovereign#051.speaker: Nawild

A People's Sovereign#052.src: No, I take that all back!
A People's Sovereign#052.speaker: Robboss

A People's Sovereign#056.src: Oh! One more thing, while you're here.
A People's Sovereign#056.dst: Ah! Bir şey daha, madem buradasın.
A People's Sovereign#056.speaker: Robboss

A People's Sovereign#057.src: Let me give you this old key. I'm not too sure where it comes from or how to use it, but surely a traveller like yourself will know what to do!
A People's Sovereign#057.dst: Sana şu {c2}eski anahtarı{/} vereyim. Nereden geldiğinden ya da nasıl kullanılacağından pek emin değilim ama senin gibi bir gezgin ne yapacağını mutlaka bilir!
A People's Sovereign#057.speaker: Robboss

A People's Sovereign#058.src: It might even be useful in this very market!
A People's Sovereign#058.speaker: Robboss

A People's Sovereign#059.src: That is all I have for you! Thank you for your business.
A People's Sovereign#059.dst: Sana verebileceklerim bu kadar! Alışverişin için teşekkürler.
A People's Sovereign#059.speaker: Robboss

A People's Sovereign#060.src: I doubt that you have anything more of interest to me, {u}.
A People's Sovereign#060.dst: Sende ilgimi çekecek başka bir şey olduğundan şüpheliyim, {u}.
A People's Sovereign#060.speaker: Robboss

A People's Sovereign#061.src: Not unless you have another feather, that is.
A People's Sovereign#061.speaker: Robboss

A People's Sovereign#062.dst: Yok mu? Ben de öyle düşünmüştüm.
A People's Sovereign#062.speaker: Robboss

A People's Sovereign#065.src: Implementation cost to be confirmed - Please consult Sovereign Rieke.
A People's Sovereign#065.dst: Uygulama maliyeti belirlenecek - Lütfen Hükümdar Rieke'ye danışın.

A People's Sovereign#068.src: Reason for denial: Suggestion would be unpopular with public.

A People's Sovereign#069.src: Reason for denial: Suggestion unpopular with Sovereign Rieke.
A People's Sovereign#069.dst: Ret gerekçesi: {c2}Öneri Hükümdar Rieke'nin hoşuna gitmiyor.{/}
